skills_registry — persist and load Deno skill entries in skills.toml.

File format (TOML, one [skill] section per entry): [skill] name = "fetch" version = "0.1.0" script = "/path/to/skill.ts" tools = "fetch_url" permissions = "--allow-net=api.example.com"

Imports

../domain/builtin_tools, ../core/pipeops

Types

SkillManifest = object
  name*: string
  version*: string
  script*: string
  tools*: seq[string]
  permissions*: seq[string]
